subject: Pilot possibilities with CirrusHealth — recap & proposed next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cirrushealth.com>, Thomas Ng <thomas@cirrushealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot possibilities with CirrusHealth — recap & proposed next steps

Hi Elena / Thomas,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and really helpful context on CirrusHealth's ingestion pipeline and latency targets. Quick recap and a couple of suggested next steps so we're all aligned: 

Summary (from our call)
- Goal: reduce inference cost per API call and improve 95th percentile latency for triage/summary workloads (current 95p ~ 1.1s).
- Scope: clinical-note summarization + reranking for physician dashboards (initial pilot slice: 5k pages/week).
- Constraints: PHI in notes; need FedRAMP-equivalent controls and on-prem / VPC option for production.

Proposed pilot (low-risk):
1) 2-week evaluation (non-prod) using Redwood Hosted + Private connector for synthetic PHI data; objective: show parity on summary quality vs current baseline and measure cost per 1k tokens.
2) If eval hits quality and latency targets, transition to a 3-month Dedicated pilot with reserved capacity and audit logs enabled.

As promised, attached are the demo slides we walked through and a short mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed timelines and responsibilities. Attachments: Cirrus_Demo_Slides.pdf, Cirrus_MAP-v1.xlsx

Open items for us to close before pilot:
- Legal: placeholder NDA already approved; need procurement contact and PO cadence.
- Security: confirmation on acceptable private deployment (VPC vs on-prem).
- Timeline: suggested kick on Apr 11 — can you confirm whether that aligns with your Q2 planning?

Next steps (suggested)
- Elena/Thomas: share procurement & security contacts by Wed 24 Mar.
- Irene/Marissa: send updated MAP and estimate (by Fri 26 Mar).

If this looks right I can schedule a short 30-min alignment next week to lock the procurement & security owners.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | (415) 555-0129

--
Attachment: Cirrus_Demo_Slides.pdf (presentation, 18 slides)
Attachment: Cirrus_MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, draft)

Just bumping this thread in case it got buried. We put together the cost/latency estimate and a trimmed MAP that removes non-essential items for the initial eval — happy to share that and walk through it.

High-level: I can get the estimate and a one-page security checklist over to your team today if you can confirm the right person to send them to (procurement or IT/Security).

If now isn't the right time, no worries — just let me know and I can follow up later. Otherwise, are you available for a quick 20-min sync next week (Apr 5–8)? I can send a few times.

Thanks!

If you're still interested we can keep it open and I can send a one-page security checklist + estimate this week. If priorities have shifted, totally fine — I can archive the file on our side and re-open later when timing is better.

Two quick options:
- Keep open: reply with the procurement/security contact or let me know a 20-min window for a sync and I’ll send the one-pager.
- Close the file: reply with “Close” and I’ll mark the opportunity as paused — happy to re-engage when the team is ready.

Appreciate a quick note either way.
